title: AYNA live run status (/ws/runs)
description: Every message on the WebSocket /ws/runs between the server and a client: what the client sends to subscribe to the tests it has open, and the run events the server sends for them (FR-20, NFR-06; ADR runs-api-and-live-updates). One JSON object per text frame; `type` tells them apart. The upgrade request carries the same Bearer token as REST: 401 without a valid one, and close code 1008 within 60 s when it expires or is revoked. Nothing is replayed: after `subscribed` and after a reconnect, read GET /api/tests/{testId}/runs?status=running and GET /api/runs/{runId} and merge by stepIndex. A reader ignores properties and message types it does not know, so additions are not breaking. Frozen as v1 with the other contracts (#52, ADR contracts-v1-freeze); changing it needs an ADR and all three owners' approval (schemas/AGENTS.md).

version.description: Version of this contract. It is not sent on the wire; bump it on every change (minor for additions, major for a breaking change).

subscribe.description: Client to server: send me the run events of this test. Answered by `subscribed`; a message without testId or with an unknown type is answered by `error` and the connection stays.

unsubscribe.description: Client to server: stop sending this test's events. Not answered.

subscribed.description: Server to client: the subscription is in place; events of this test follow from now on.

runStarted.description: Server to client: a run of the test started (POST /api/runs).

runFinished.description: Server to client: a run of the test finished (POST /api/runs/{runId}/finish).

runStepResult.description: Server to client: a step result was stored (PUT /api/runs/{runId}/results/{stepIndex}). A repeat of a stored result is not sent again.

stepIndex.description: Position of the step in the step document copied when the run started, from 0.

error.description: Server to client: the last client message could not be used. The connection stays open.

runStatus.description: Status of a run. New values may be added in a minor version (#74 adds repairProposed); show an unknown one as it is.

stepStatus.description: Status of a step result. New values may be added in a minor version (#74 adds repairProposed); show an unknown one as it is.

runSummary.description: A run without its step document and results; the shape of RunSummary in docs/api/openapi.yaml.

startedBy.description: Who started the run; username is null once that account is deleted.

finishedAt.description: Null while the run is running.

durationMs.description: Null while the run is running.
